summary_en: WDI Corporation executed a block purchase of 16,000 shares at 3,220 yen per share on the ToSTNeT-3 system on November 13, 2026, for a total of 52 million yen, representing 0.3% of outstanding shares excluding treasury stock.
title_en: Notice of Acquisition of Treasury Stock and Block Purchase of Treasury Stock via Over-the-Counter Transaction (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief:
On November 12, 2026, WDI Corporation's Board of Directors resolved to execute a block purchase of treasury stock via an over-the-counter transaction on the Tokyo Stock Exchange. The purchase was executed on November 13, 2026, at 8:45 a.m. on the ToSTNeT-3 system.

The company purchased 16,000 shares at a fixed price of 3,220 yen per share, which was the closing price on November 12, 2026. The total consideration was 52 million yen. Based on the reference data of 6,331,920 shares outstanding as of September 30, 2026, this purchase represents 0.3% of shares outstanding excluding treasury stock.

The company stated that the acquisition was conducted to implement flexible capital policy in response to changes in the management environment. Results of the block purchase were announced after the trading session on November 13, 2026.
